Build both platforms from the same source revision and state that revision here. If revisions differ, attach separately named matching source archives for Windows and Linux. Keep the extracted folder `dekui/` and executables `Dekui.exe` / `Dekui.AppImage` unchanged. For subsequent releases, update the version in all download names and the tag/title together.

## Installation

Extract the full package, place your supported decrypted USA v1.1 game-card dump beside the app, and launch. Preserve your game and `user/` folder when updating.
